parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS instance.

parameters.name: ProtectedFromScaleIn
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to protect ECS instances from being terminated or removed from the scaling group during a scale-in activity. Valid values: 

- true: Protects the ECS instances.
- false: Does not protect the ECS instances.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.
